title: Design an Enterprise RAG & LLM Inference Gateway
prompt: Design a multi-tenant Enterprise RAG & LLM Gateway serving 2,000 QPS with sub-400ms Time To First Token (TTFT), strict tenant ACL enforcement, semantic caching, and token-aware rate limiting.

spark.summary: Design a multi-tenant Enterprise RAG & LLM Gateway serving 2,000 QPS with sub-400ms Time To First Token (TTFT), strict tenant ACL enforcement, semantic caching, and token-aware rate limiting.
spark.keyTakeaway: To keep serving pipelines predictable under bursty prompts, fast TTFT, zero ACL leaks, and predictable token spend.
spark.byteSummary:
Design a multi-tenant Enterprise RAG & LLM Gateway serving 2,000 QPS with sub-400ms Time To First Token (TTFT), strict tenant ACL enforcement, semantic caching, and token-aware rate limiting.

The design partitions state, bounds tail latency, and isolates failure domains.

Fast TTFT, zero ACL leaks, and predictable token spend.

stages.title: ACL-filtered Hybrid Retrieval & Reranking
stages.prompt: Combine dense HNSW vector search with sparse BM25 lexical search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), filtering strictly by the user's document ACLs *before* ranking. Read more on how [Input & Output Tokens](/concept/input-and-output-tokens) shape prompt budgets.

keyInsights: Enforce tenant/role ACL filters inside the vector index metadata filter—never filter only after retrieving Top-K.
Use a lightweight cross-encoder reranker to narrow Top-50 hybrid hits down to the 5 sharpest chunks.

tradeOffs.pro: Sub-20ms cache hits for recurring queries
tradeOffs.con: Must key cache by `(tenant_id, acl_group)` to prevent cross-tenant data leaks

stages.title: Token Budgeting, Prefix Caching & Rate Limiting
stages.prompt: Track token-per-minute (TPM) quotas in [Redis](/domains/redis) alongside request-per-minute limits, and place static system prompts at index 0 so the [LLM](/domains/llm) engine reuses KV prefix caches.

keyInsights: Reserve `max_tokens` for output before fitting retrieved chunks into the context window.
Stream responses over SSE so users perceive low latency even when Decode takes several seconds.

failureModes.name: Cross-Tenant Semantic Cache Leak
failureModes.description: User B hits a cached answer generated from User A's confidential document.
failureModes.mitigation: Partition semantic cache keys by tenant and permission hash.

putItTogether.title: Put the Enterprise RAG Gateway together
putItTogether.summary: Unite [Redis](/domains/redis) semantic/token rate limiting, ACL-enforced hybrid retrieval, and KV-cache-friendly prompt assembly for [LLM](/domains/llm) serving.
steps: Check tenant-scoped semantic cache and TPM token bucket in Redis.
Run ACL-filtered Hybrid Search (Dense + BM25) and rerank to Top-5 chunks.
Assemble prompt with static prefix first and stream tokens via SSE.
putItTogether.outcome: Fast TTFT, zero ACL leaks, and predictable token spend.

questions.prompt: What is the biggest security risk of adding a Redis semantic cache in front of a multi-tenant Enterprise RAG system?

options.text: Serving a cached answer retrieved from Document X to a user without permission to read Document X
options.explanation: Correct! Semantic caches must be scoped by tenant and user ACL group.
Cache hits bypass LLM tokenization and inference entirely.

prerequisites.title: input-and-output-tokens
prerequisites.summary: Understand how BPE tokenization splits text into subwords, why input tokens (Prefill) and output tokens (Decode) have radically different latency, KV-cache, and pricing profiles, and how to budget context windows.

prerequisites.title: RAG Retrieval Pipelines
prerequisites.summary: Production RAG retrieval combines semantic chunking, hybrid dense (HNSW) + sparse (BM25/SPLADE) search, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), metadata pre-filtering, and cross-encoder reranking to deliver high-precision context to LLMs.

prerequisites.title: Semantic Caching for LLMs
prerequisites.summary: Semantic LLM caching intercepts natural-language prompts, embeds them into dense vectors (e.g., 1536-dim via text-embedding-3-small), and performs an Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) lookup in a vector store like Redis or Qdrant. When cosine similarity clear...

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement Design an Enterprise RAG & LLM Inference Gateway without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: To keep serving pipelines predictable under bursty prompts, fast TTFT, zero ACL leaks, and predictable token spend.
decisionFramework.tradeOffs: Gains predictable p99 latency and fault isolation in exchange for explicit bounding, observability, and slightly higher implementation complexity.

decisionExercise.prompt: When Design an Enterprise RAG & LLM Inference Gateway experiences a sudden 5x traffic spike alongside a slow downstream dependency, which engineering choice best protects system stability?

options.label: Increase retry counts and remove client timeouts so every request eventually succeeds.
options.explanation: Unbounded retries multiply load on an already struggling dependency and exhaust worker pools.

options.label: Enforce strict latency budgets, bounded jittered retries, and graceful fallback or load shedding.
options.explanation: Bounding retries and isolating slow paths preserves healthy capacity and keeps tail latency predictable.
